chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: The music director's duties with Armstrong; the film "Pillar to Post"
summary: McRae handled broadcasts, arrangements and rehearsals for Armstrong, who wanted no responsibility, including a MGM soundtrack.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And when we would play -- when we have these rehearsals, that's what you got to do. Like when we did the command performance -- we were playing
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
at the Trianon Ballroom -- they came out to talk to Louie Armstrong about the performance on the show, he sent him over to me. He say, "Go see my music director."
You got all the responsibility. You got to set up the broadcast -- what's going to be broadcast.
I used to call up NBC or CBS, "Look, we're gonna do -- here's our program for the next two shows," understand?
You break it down, you give -- Louis say, "What we gonna do?" So you (inaudible) got that sheet for him. You give a sheet on what you're for the going to do on the broadcast, (Inaudible) band.
All that stuff you have to do. Take care all the arrangements, rehearse the band before we even play, run down the arrangements while Louie is sitting there looking. "Louie, okay, we're ready."
He knows where he's supposed to come in at. Then he'll take over.
Did you do all the copying
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
No, I had a copyist and everything. I didn't do all that copying and all that stuff.
Some of guys in the band would copy. When we did that picture, that Pillar To Post thing, we brought in arrangers --
What's the name?
Pillar To Post.
Pillar To Post?
Yeah. It was a big thing on MGM.
And we went out there and we did that. It was a week doing that.
And we did the whole soundtrack before we even did any (inaudible) the picture. We did all the music that they was going to do in the show. We did all the music that had to be done.
Then we go out and make the soundtrack. And that's what we worked to, we don't play nothing. We just sit up on the stand and go through the motions.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
And Louie don't want to know from nothing. You got to do all of that, you got to get out there and see that everything is set up.
You to agree to this, you got to agree to that.
And one of the biggest things -- they gonna test me. I guess Joe Glaser said, 'Well, we'll test this guy. We'll see what' --
